messages:
incident-bot: Postmortem 'api-latency-spike' - action item #4 (owner: @maya) is 5 days overdue. Please update status or reassign. Tracker: https://redwood.company/pm/postmortems/aps-2026/actions :eyes:
maya: Sorry — slipped off my queue. Blocked by a failing autoscaler test and an unexpected GPU driver mismatch on dedicated. PR in progress, will push update today.
liam: Can you paste the failing test logs? We need to assess rollback risk for tonight's deploy.
maya: copying logs snippet:
```
E0623 14:12:33 scaler.go:214] autoscale: reconcile failed: driver mismatch: expected nvidia-525, found nvidia-470
Traceback: ...
```
liam: Oof. That's a kernel/driver rollout gap. If the patch doesn't land we should gate the deploy.
tanya_oncall: @maya can you confirm whether the rollback guard is enabled? If not, escalate to @eng-oncall immediately. This is high risk for customer-facing latency.
maya: Rollback guard not enabled by default on that cluster. I can enable it but need access to the infra change window (30m).
jordan_pm: This is blocking the feature release next week. If it can't land by EOD tomorrow, we need to freeze the release and notify stakeholders.
maya: Acknowledged. I'll move this to P1, pairing with @liam tomorrow 10:00 PT to finish tests and flip the guard.
incident-bot: Reminder set: follow up with @maya in 48h.
eng-oncall: If pair can't finish tomorrow, escalate to infra oncall for driver rollback. We'll keep deploys gated.
liam: I'll carve out 10-11am PT to pair. If we hit infra access issues, ping me here and I'll open a support task with infra ops.
maya: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/patches/432 — includes driver detection and a guard toggle. Requesting review.
tanya_oncall: Please add a short mitigation note in the postmortem doc about temporary routing to region-b while fix is validated.
maya: Done — updated postmortem and action tracker with ETA: +1 business day, owner remains @maya unless reassigned.
(48h later)
maya: Update: PR reviewed and merged, canary deployed to 10% traffic, metrics look stable. Pushing to 100% in 30m. :white_check_mark:
jordan_pm: Thanks — can you paste the canary perf numbers when available? Need to confirm we didn't regress latency p95.
maya: Canary p95 unchanged (63ms -> 65ms), error rate flat. Pushing full deployment now.
eng-oncall: Saw rollout, no alerts.
tanya_oncall: Closing action item #4 as done in tracker and postmortem. Marking remediation complete.
maya: Leaving a note with root cause and permanent fix steps in the postmortem. Closing on my end. :wave:
